statements.status_notes: Upstream Redis 8.2.9 fixes use-after-free in tlsProcessPendingData() TLS pending-data list iteration (https://github.com/redis/redis/commit/6d088c335d5c3ec49a6c28486140b498e70b7834). See https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-81934.

Upstream Redis 8.2.9 fixes use-after-free in tlsProcessPendingData() TLS pending-data list iteration (https://github.com/redis/redis/commit/6d088c335d5c3ec49a6c28486140b498e70b7834). See https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-81934.

Debian security tracker lists trixie 5:8.0.2-3+deb13u2 as (unfixed) with urgency unimportant. Redis GHSA-2r7g-8hpc-rpq9 states authenticated multi-bulk RESP use does not violate the Redis Security Model and no code fix is planned. An authenticated client can trigger the described memory consumption, so not_affected cannot be claimed; no Debian or upstream patch is available to backport.

Disputed and unreproducible upstream: NVD/CVE describe a segmentation fault in redis-server 5.0.7, but Redis maintainers could not reproduce it in a released 5.0.7 build (https://github.com/redis/redis/issues/6633). Debian security tracker lists trixie 5:8.0.2-3+deb13u2 as (unfixed) with urgency unimportant and notes negligible security impact.
Valkey hardening change comparing prev->used < prev->size in setDeferredReply (commit 374718b2a365ca69f715d542709b7d71540b1387). Applied in package/deb/main/redis/patch/CVE-2025-49112.patch.

Upstream Redis 8.6.3 fix checks processCommandAndResetClient return when re-executing blocked commands (commit c14e9925e571c3c8ecbeb8632fe834faa32175ea). Applied in package/deb/main/redis/patch/CVE-2026-23479.patch.

Debian bookworm security backport validates RESTORE serialized values to block invalid memory access (upstream commit b9dde6fc25dec6191b18374335a076a7b31e3d02). Applied in package/deb/main/redis/patch/CVE-2026-25243.patch.

Debian bookworm security backport delays fullsync while a timed-out Lua script runs on replicas (upstream commit 0cca172a174642bdae03b871615227896274d9bb). Applied in package/deb/main/redis/patch/CVE-2026-23631.patch.

Debian bookworm security backport rejects corrupt stream RDB payloads where the same NACK is referenced by multiple consumers (upstream commit 4f62a8bf15c634187d8a87d874f8988032f90b6c). Applied in package/deb/main/redis/patch/CVE-2026-66373.patch.
